input.format: ELF64 x86-64, static, no libc, no build-id

observation.ordering: function names are fixture order; body ranges/instructions and event batches preserve native forward order; references include both untouched native order and an explicit canonical sorted projection
observation.normalization: addresses retain space and offset; packed p-code is byte exact; event records preserve one total delivery order while nondeterministic asynchronous dispatch-batch boundaries are omitted; event affected-object identity is mapped to deterministic first-seen ordinals

conditional cross-function jump remains NONE with the option disabled
conditional cross-function jump becomes CALL_RETURN with the option enabled
exact global name exit is marked no-return by the Known analyzer
reference deletion/recreation, flow-override and function-change event order
raw versus override-aware p-code and packed p-code for every fixture instruction
pre-analyzer, immediate post-analyzer and analysis-queue-settled Program state
untested_residual: Rugra bilateral Program metadata import and live flow consumption
pointer labels resolving to external no-return functions
multiple outgoing memory flow references and their native-array first-reference quirk
